excluded.reason: Syncfusion marks locale @private and @aspIgnore in node_modules/@syncfusion/ej2-navigations/src/breadcrumb/breadcrumb.d.ts:207-210 — it is an internal globalization hook, not a public runtime value. No Senior Living navigation use case reads or branches on a private locale key (care/service trails, resident-directory and billing breadcrumbs act on item text/url/id); the MVC BreadcrumbBuilder does not expose it. Onboarding a vendor-private member as typed DSL would expose an unstable internal contract; excluded from the public Fusion slice.
